response.query: What predefined safety gates, systemic IGF-axis monitoring assays, biodistribution criteria, animal models, and explicit go/no-go rules will guide progression from ex vivo engagement to in vivo testing?
response.answer: Safety gates include preclinical efficacy and toxicity studies; systemic IGF-axis assays monitor growth factor levels; biodistribution criteria assess organ uptake; animal models like mice are used; go/no-go rules depend on data from these assessments.
